sources.prompt: Edit this ORIGINAL VFX source sheet, preserving EXACTLY the 3 columns x 5 rows layout, each move silhouette and all fifteen independent sprites. Keep TRUE transparent alpha, remove any background, no characters, letters, symbols or additional sprites. These green thorn effects are TOO DARK at mobile size. Repaint EVERY effect with MUCH BRIGHTER and THICKER MINT-IVORY edge cores and luminous pale turquoise midtones, keeping deep blackberry under-contours so they still pop against gold armor. All 15 sprites including prepare and sparse settles need bold clearly visible HIGH VALUE white-mint edged strokes at 60px display width on navy; not just tiny edge glints. Target a painted ivory-to-mint ribbon along at least 1/3 of every thorn edge, with solid dark plum under-edge, NO broad haze. Row 5 should be BRIGHT coral/ivory with ruby under-contours, not dark blood-red. Keep the precise existing designs: row1 soft open thorn curves and knot, row2 thorn flower, row3 rigid locked brackets and narrow spear storm, row4 locked brackets and three separated gusts, row5 red phase thorns. Maintain ENOUGH CLEAR TRANSPARENT GUTTERS; scale motifs slightly smaller if necessary, no visible shape clipped at borders or cell boundaries. Every spike completely visible. Normal alpha blending, no reliance on additive. Pale mint ivory edges must make even the tiny settle remnants clearly legible. Never add floor ellipses, letters, runes, real-world emblems or characters.
sources.use: Only clean first row Gather Thorns selected; lower rows replaced by single-move sources.

sources.prompt: Paint ORIGINAL isolated fantasy combat VFX, TRUE transparent RGBA background. No characters, hands, letters, numbers, glyphs, symbols, UI, scenery, or floor circles. ONE contact sheet portrait aspect 3:5 with EXACTLY 3 columns and 5 rows of equal cells, invisible grid, generous blank transparent gutters between all 15 effects and 15 percent blank margins per cell. Painterly mobile RPG style, textured chunky shards and ribbons with clear small-scale silhouettes. Palette dark indigo/aubergine outlines, saturated violet interiors and sharp cyan-white edge cores; subtle antique gold accents only. Must remain legible over dark navy and gold armour with NORMAL alpha blending. Column order small PREPARE, large PEAK, sparse SETTLE. Enemy on RIGHT faces LEFT; all directional releases point LEFT. Row1 RIFT GATHERING normal interruptible charge: two soft separated violet wisps curling inward with hollow center; compressed compact open rift spindle; two loose violet motes. Use soft open arcs clearly different from hard unstoppable brackets. Row2 RIFT WAVE ALL heroes: small curling crescent seed; three separated tall lateral scythe wave slices leaning LEFT with white rims and violet dark cores; three small broken wave fragments. Row3 RIFT CATACLYSM UNSTOPPABLE single heavy strike: double rigid interlocked jagged crystal brackets enclosing generous EMPTY center; enormous angular downward cleaving violet crystal wedge with explosive prismatic splinters and sharp ivory contact core, no smooth round explosion; three fading dark crystalline embers. Row4 RIFT AWAKENING phase change: small separated amethyst fracture slivers; two outward opening fractured crystal wings on each side of a large EMPTY centre, laced with cyan seams (abstract energy only, no biological wings); separated quiet violet glowing fragments. Row5 CALL THE RIFT summon portal: two curled vertical violet tear wisps; a tall UPRIGHT irregular dimensional tear with black-violet void centre framed by crystalline ivory-cyan rim, unambiguously upright not a floor ellipse, no signs or runes; two dissolving vertical rim fragments. No gold-only effects, no broad fog discs. All fifteen isolated pieces centered within their respective grid cells. Keep plenty of space at every edge; nothing clipped.
